source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of October 16, 2026, there were 288,434,583 shares of the registrant's common stock outstanding.

notes: Common stock only, listed on the NYSE as GS. Goldman Sachs also has several series of non-cumulative preferred stock outstanding (some listed as depositary shares); they are fixed-claim securities, not common equity, and are left out.
